parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the name of the class (group) of fundamental particles that contains a neutrino.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: A hadron $P$ has a charge of $+1e$, where $e$ is the elementary charge. The hadron $P$ is composed of a down antiquark and only one other quark.
parts.text: Identify a possible flavour for this other quark.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State what type of hadron is $P$.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.part_stem:
Nucleus $Q$ undergoes radioactive decay to form nucleus $R$, emitting an antineutrino and another particle $X$, as shown in the decay equation.

$$Q \rightarrow R + X + \bar{\nu}$$
parts.text: State what particle is represented by $X$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Compare the nucleon numbers of $Q$ and $R$.
